capabilities.capturedLocals: reject the complete program with r03-d-capability before returning any IR; do not classify genuine Source as invalid
capabilities.capturedSlots: only bindings with role parameter; scalar and callable parameter slots supported
capabilities.controls: scalar operations, local definitions and rebinding, block, if, while, shortCircuit, return, direct call and closure call
capabilities.functions: emit the complete verified function set without root or target-set pruning
capabilities.unsupported: no physical heap or Handle encoding, Core CLI consumer, C++ dialect or root recomputation, wire packet, runtime execution, or formal registry admission

identity.digest: sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits; equality uses the complete identity
identity.metadataNone: empty string denotes absent parent or environment in metadata only; no Source nullable type is introduced
identity.program: sha256 of UTF8 printClosureEnvironments(verifiedProgram,hir), including its final LF
identity.sourceSignature: original Source callable TypeId and signatureHash; hidden Core environment is excluded from the Source signature hash
identity.symbol: f followed by all 64 hexadecimal digits of the original FunctionId

limitScope.coreParameters: per function including at most one hidden environment
limitScope.emissionWork: whole emission; exhaustion rejects without partial output

operationSignatures.cf.cond_br: i1 condition and typed successor argument transfers
operationSignatures.func.call: (hidden target env iff required, Source arguments in declaration order) -> Source result type
operationSignatures.scalar: existing exact scalar Core operand/result categories; closure and environment types are never scalar type codes
operationSignatures.tsfg_closure.call: (saved closure<C>, Source arguments in declaration order) -> Source result type; signature identifies C
operationSignatures.tsfg_closure.env.alloc:
(parent env

iff layout.parent is nonempty) -> env
operationSignatures.tsfg_closure.env.init: (owner activation env<L>, corresponding actual parameter T) -> (); slot binding has type T and role parameter
operationSignatures.tsfg_closure.env.parent:
(env) -> env

; P equals layout L parent
operationSignatures.tsfg_closure.env.store: (env<L>, slot type T) -> (); writable must be true
operationSignatures.tsfg_closure.make: (env<L> iff target lexical environment is nonempty) -> closure<target Source callable TypeId>

ordering.function: functionAttributes in listed order; implicit sym_name and function_type come from MLIR function syntax
ordering.metadata: dictionary keys in exactFields listed order; types, environments and functions retain verified program order; parameters retain Source declaration order
ordering.operations: operationAttributes in listed order, then sourceAttributes
ordering.text: bounded UTF8 MLIR text with exactly one final LF; metadata integers use i64 and booleans use true/false
ordering.values: arguments left to right after the complete callee closure pair is evaluated and saved; definitions reuse SSA values

semantics.allocation: env.alloc is an operation inside each owning function entry, after existing function fuel; every invocation creates a fresh environment; static layout is not an instance
semantics.anchors: alloc uses function-entry definitionRange and anchor_kind function-entry; init uses parameter range and anchor_kind parameter; other operations retain original ranges
semantics.authority: Node compilation output only, no parser/verifier/GC/VM/Runtime/RF success or formal ABI adoption
semantics.closures: make combines original full FunctionId and matching lexical environment without additional environment allocation; same code identity does not imply same environment instance
semantics.control: shared existing typed scalar CFG and phi transfer semantics; closure values remain whole across joins
semantics.directCall: preserve direct classification, full FunctionId and signature attributes; do not rewrite a closure call from singleton target analysis
semantics.fuel: retain event 1 at function entry and event 2 at loop header; no new fuel event for environment operations
semantics.hiddenEnvironment: first Core parameter and first direct-call operand iff lexicalEnvironment is nonempty; followed by every original Source parameter
semantics.indirectCall: evaluate and save the complete callee pair before ordered arguments, then call that saved SSA value; argument rebinding cannot replace it
semantics.initialization: captured parameters initialize in Source parameter order from actual parameter SSA values before the Source body; do not substitute zero/null or prior activation data
semantics.locals: noncaptured local and alias reads reuse definitions; rebinding creates a new selected SSA definition
semantics.roots: no producer root register map; root_policy consumer-recompute-required; future consumer must distinguish environment roots and the environment component of closure values
semantics.slots: original BindingId and TypeId; parent is a typed strong managed edge; no per-closure copies of mutable bindings
semantics.wire9: base identity only; this Node producer emits no bytecode and establishes no wire9 closure encoding
semantics.writes: store consumes one evaluated RHS; environmentWrite returns that same RHS SSA; parameter slot must be writable

types.closureRepresentation: one logical SSA value containing the complete 256-bit FunctionId and absent or managed environment; no physical struct ABI or persistent code pointer
